meta.material_change_flag: yes: Adams County OH certified the Sprigg (332-301) and Monroe (149-102) township zoning adoptions (first county-certified Nov 3 results in coverage); Butler County PC recommended St. Clair Twp data-center prohibition affecting the AWS Trenton-area campus; Virginia governor and legislative leaders proposed ending by-right approval for >25 MW data centers (ladder 2, no bill filed)
meta.headline: Material-change statement: YES — three confirmed material changes, none of which is an enacted ban.
